summary: Prepare for the PECB Lead Cybersecurity Manager exam with five days of cybersecurity programme, risk, control, incident, and performance training.
audienceIntro: This five-day course is intended for people who manage cybersecurity responsibilities or contribute directly to implementing cybersecurity strategies and measures. It also suits professionals who advise on cybersecurity risk, compliance, and management decisions.
audience: Cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance managers
prerequisites: To fully benefit from this course, you should have a fundamental understanding of cybersecurity concepts and management.
